title: Always-on health card backdrop paints over the app HUD title every frame
evidence:
draw_text(app, "Packet Plumber - v2 story 4.3 (network health + win/lose/retry)", 12, 10, 22, p.ink)
---
x := (v.win_w - card_w) / 2
y := i32(10)
---
rl.DrawRectangle(x - pad, y - pad, card_w + 2 * pad, HEALTH_CARD_H, rl.Color{255, 244, 236, 240})
---
rnd.draw_health_meter(&app.view, &app.state.health, &app.cat, app.state.health_enabled)  [app/main.odin:776, drawn after the title]
---
int charsWidth[224] = { 3, 1, 4, 6, 5, 7, 6, 2, 3, 3, 5, 5, 2, 4, 1, 7, 5, 2, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 5, 1, 1, 3, 4, 3, 6,  [tools/raylib-sw/src/src/rtext.c:220]
detail: Card backdrop (x 410-870, y 0-52, near-opaque) draws after the ~746px-wide title (12,10) per the default-font metrics, permanently covering its right half; 'NETWORK HEALTH' then renders on top. The harness capture never draws the title, so no golden catches it.
recommended_fix: Move the card below the title row (e.g. y = 34) or shorten the title; ideally the render package owns the placement so app and capture share it.

title: Banner-offset layout policy duplicated between app and harness call sites
detail: The offset policy (10 + HEALTH_CARD_H + 6, magic gap 6) lives in both draw_hud and capture_frame; changing one site silently diverges the app from the blessed capture frames it must mirror.
recommended_fix: Export the policy from render (e.g. `banner_y(health_on: bool) -> i32` next to HEALTH_CARD_H) and call it from both draw_hud and capture_frame.

title: Win toast copy keys on session config, not on which condition fired
detail: The outcome enum carries no source, and the copy branches on the surge_win_pct flag: a session with goal>0 and surge_win_pct>0 would mislabel a deliver-N goal win as 'SURGE SURVIVED'.
recommended_fix: Key the copy on the actual win source (surge_done/ratio vs goal from the state) or assert the session enables only one win path.
